result.summary: nativecode.ai scores 76/100, which places it at Competitive. In short, the site competes in classic search but is leaving AI-search visibility on the table. Its strongest area is technical SEO (100/100); the fastest gains are in answer engine readiness (54/100).

top_fixes.title: Add author bios, credentials and review signals
top_fixes.why: Authorship and expertise are core trust inputs for both Google and AI engines.
top_fixes.fix: Attach credentialed author bios and reviewer signals to substantive content.

top_fixes.title: Build 'best / vs / alternative' comparison pages
top_fixes.why: Comparison queries are high-intent and disproportionately surfaced in AI answers.
top_fixes.fix: Create objective comparison pages targeting your category's buying queries.

top_fixes.title: Cite primary sources in substantive content
top_fixes.why: Well-sourced content is more trustworthy to cite than unsupported claims.
top_fixes.fix: Reference primary data and authoritative sources where you make claims.
